ois.design.acoustic-phone-booth: Floor, roof and padded walls form an occupiable booth containing a desk and fixed seat; open front is visible. This is a room enclosure, not a storage cabinet.
ois.design.aquarium-console: Four actual glass tank walls and a tank base sit above a supporting storage pedestal; no cabinet door pattern is being counted as a fish tank.
ois.design.barrel-lid-trunk: Curved barrel lid and boxed lower storage shell; the banded sibling is explicitly one non-counting trim variant.
ois.design.butcher-drawer-island: Thick projecting butcher-block worktop, plinth kitchen carcase and two independent drawer banks; unlike the tall legged jewellery chest, this is a preparation island.
ois.design.cane-bedside: Physical woven-grid front in framed hinged door, backed by interior shelves and supported on timber feet. Wider door-count siblings are non-counting.
ois.design.cane-linen-tower: Multiple separately framed woven door cells with internal divisions, rather than one open compartment or full-height hanging rail. Cell-count/size siblings are non-counting.
ois.design.cleaning-locker-tower: Divided louvred compartments and continuous recessed floor plinth. Ventilation uses real angled slats; no glazed display panels or drawer boxes.
ois.design.corner-carousel: Quarter-circle case surrounds stacked circular turntable trays with central spindle and perimeter guards; rectangular case silhouette does not describe its accessible interior construction.
ois.design.counter-microwave: Horizontal glazed cooking aperture, cavity lining, turntable and separate controls. Appliance distinction; excluded from core furniture subtotal.
ois.design.curved-track-shower: Curved glass screen follows curved top/bottom tracks; directly inspected against square shower enclosure with three flat panes. Bathroom fixture excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.deep-drawer-base: Full-width independent drawer boxes with side runners inside a plinth-mounted base cabinet. No hinged framed cupboard doors or hanging rail.
ois.design.double-drawer-vanity: Two real hollow basins and faucets sit over drawer cabinetry. The paired sink plumbing surfaces distinguish it from a plain drawer chest; fixture excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.double-wall-oven: Two glazed cooking cavities with independent racks and doors. Appliance excluded from core furniture subtotal.
ois.design.four-bay-display: Physical framed glass doors expose actual internal display shelves. Door-count relatives of other sizes remain variants; glazing differs from woven or louvred enclosure.
ois.design.framed-shower-cube: Three flat glass screens, separate door handle, square tray and shower riser; differs from the curved-screen shower. Fixture excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.french-door-fridge: Split upper insulated doors plus separate bottom freezer drawer, with real external handles. Appliance excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.glass-wall-cupboard: Wall-mounted glazed case with interior shelves and no floor legs. Wall anchoring and transparent front differ from a legged sideboard.
ois.design.hinged-laundry-hamper: Thin walls enclose a hollow top-loading hamper beneath a separate lifting lid; no frontal drum, controls or internal appliance mechanism.
ois.design.integrated-dishwasher: Front appliance door, control fascia and inset glazing within a plinth-height housing. Appliance excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.jewellery-bureau: Multiple drawer boxes, backs, bottoms, side walls and fixed runners form the small-drawer grid. Different grid counts/dimensions in this construction are already non-counting.
ois.design.kitchen-wall-pantry: Full-height framed door faces enclose shelving over a kitchen plinth; no wardrobe hanging rail. Door-count and dimension siblings do not add counts.
ois.design.lift-lid-storage-bench: Connected slatted seat over a low enclosed storage chest, with lid hinges and floor supports; differs from curved-lid trunk and hollow hamper.
ois.design.louver-shoe-cupboard: Two framed doors contain actual angled louvres over low shelved storage on legs. Wider louvred credenza is a non-counting sibling.
ois.design.louvered-armoire: Full-height louvred doors enclose a hanging rail and upper shelf, rather than the shoe cupboard shelf layout. Hanging function has actual internal geometry.
ois.design.mesh-clothes-cabinet: Metal-grid full-height doors enclose a clothing rail and upper shelf on an exposed steel frame; mesh and hanging interior differ from louvred or shelved pantry construction.
ois.design.metal-mesh-pantry: Metal-grid framed doors reveal separate pantry shelves over steel sleds. Mesh office cabinet is already a dimension variant; clothing cabinet has a rail instead of these shelves.
ois.design.open-shoe-slope-rack: Tilted exposed shoe shelves and retaining edges on open side supports; no doors or enclosing rectangular storage shell.
ois.design.retro-two-door-fridge: Two vertically stacked rounded insulated doors and long pulls; appliance excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.rolling-appliance-garage: Horizontal roll-up tambour curtain, upper shutter housing and open counter cavity; differs from vertical-stave enclosed bedside storage.
ois.design.server-equipment-rack: Actual ten server face units and indicators sit behind transparent doors in a deep equipment case; distinct interior hardware, not an empty glass display cupboard.
ois.design.shaker-single-vanity: Hollow rectangular sink, faucet and counter over framed-door base cabinet. Fixture excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.shaker-three-door-console: Framed recessed-panel hinged doors and interior shelves on timber feet. Tall single-door dimension sibling is already excluded.
ois.design.shaker-wardrobe: Recessed framed doors surround an actual hanging rail and top shelf, unlike the console shelf-only interior. Door counts alone are not counted.
ois.design.six-burner-range: Six separate burner rings, controls and glazed oven cavity with racks. Appliance excluded from core furniture subtotal.
ois.design.steel-mesh-locker-bank: Final repair v0.7.1 has actual metal-grid cell fronts; old v0.7.0 cane-front revision is withheld. Multiple separately hinged lockers, not one full-height pantry compartment.
ois.design.tambour-bedside: Continuous physical vertical staves make the tambour front above supporting legs; cabinet size and wider/taller stave-front relatives are already non-counting.
ois.design.three-drawer-nightstand: Independent full-width drawer boxes with runners and timber legs. Taller narrow stack is a non-counting sibling; multiple bank relatives have different bank partitions.
ois.design.two-drawer-wide-chest: Broad low independent drawers over recessed continuous plinth, unlike the legged nightstand support. Extra drawer count alone is not the basis of distinction.
ois.design.upright-freezer: Single full-height insulated front door with long pull and enclosed refrigeration shell. Appliance excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.utility-pet-crate: Low wire-grid hinged doors and enclosed sides/back create ventilated pet access at floor level; actual cage aperture, not a solid storage door.
ois.design.vented-bath-locker: Multiple separate framed louvre cells on steel sled base. Cleaning tower uses a continuous plinth; these supports and compartment interiors are modelled, not colour-only changes.
ois.design.vessel-top-console: Raised hollow oval vessel and faucet above a timber-door console. Fixture excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.wine-cooling-cabinet: Transparent refrigerator door reveals actual bottle racks and bottle cylinders; appliance excluded from core subtotal.
ois.design.wine-diagonal-cabinet: Physical diagonal X partitions create diamond wine cells within a floor-supported enclosure; smaller open wine lattice is explicitly non-counting.
ois.design.writing-bureau-cabinet: Hinged horizontal leaf, diagonal metal stays, upper closed panel and open lower case. Direct comparison found slab-front fold-down-dressing-case to be the same construction; it is now non-counting.
ois.design.captain-storage-bed: Enclosed raised bed frame contains accessible side drawers, actual drawer boxes and sleeping platform. Full/king/twin entries remain mattress-size variants.
ois.design.channel-upholstered-bed: Broad padded headboard with channel face and raised sleeping platform. Tufted decorative face and all mattress sizes do not add separate design counts.
ois.design.draped-canopy-bed: Four tall corner posts and upper rails carry four gathered fabric curtains around the platform. Mattress-size relatives are non-counting.
ois.design.floating-platform-bed: Deeply inset support plinth under cantilevered sleeping deck, with tall head panel. All mattress sizes use the same construction and are non-counting variants.
ois.design.pullout-trundle-bed: Main raised bed plus separate deployed floor-supported caster trundle and second mattress. Final v0.7.9 is reviewed separately; earlier floor-pivot versions are withheld.
ois.design.slatted-low-bed: Open flat headboard slats and low platform frame. All mattress sizes share the construction and do not increase the count.
ois.design.sled-double-dresser: Two actual drawer banks on exposed steel sled underframe, unlike timber-foot jewellery drawer grid or plinth low chest. Bank-size siblings are not independent designs.
ois.design.sleigh-panel-bed: Curved swept end uprights carry solid head and foot panels. Full/king/twin dimensions do not add designs.
ois.design.spindle-head-bed: Individual turned cylindrical spindles and rounded posts carry open head and foot rails; flat slat headboard uses a different joinery profile. Mattress-size variants excluded.
ois.design.wing-headboard-bed: Deep upholstered side wings project beside pillows from padded headboard. Mattress sizes do not add design counts.
